messages:
maya: quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a cross-environment quant bakeoff for stella-13b covering FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ. Goal is to measure accuracy delta vs fp16 and produce deployment profiles for hosted, dedicated, private. launching a dry-run tonight. :rocket:

maya: main asks: 1) sample sets we should use, 2) ramp policy suggestions per env, 3) pass/fail thresholds (accuracy + perf), 4) any infra checks for private nodes.

tom: +1. For sampling I suggest weighted sample by real traffic mix but with an over-sample of low-resource prompts (short inputs) and long-context cases. rough split: 80% hosted-like, 15% dedicated-like, 5% private-like. probe fraction for quant variants: start at 0.5% of bucketed traffic. :eyes:

sasha: prefer a small "corridor" rollout (avoid the word canary to reduce confusion) — start 0.5% user-bucket, hold for 6h, check quality metrics and latency, then 2%, hold 12h, then 10% if green. keep automatic rollback on quality regression > delta threshold.

eli: what are the exact acceptance criteria? need to be explicit for automation.

maya: good call. propose pass criteria: - QA tasks: F1/EM delta <= 1.0 absolute points vs fp16 baseline - Summarization: ROUGE-L delta <= 1.5 - Latency P95 <= 1.5x fp16 baseline and P99 no more than 2x - Token unit cost reduction >= 8% (so cost wins) - No new safety classifiers triggered in 1h window. If any fail, auto-fallback to fp16 variant for that corridor.

frank: add infra checks: KV-cache memory growth < 10% over baseline, no OOMs, GPU temperature and PCI errors flagged. private envs need explicit heartbeat and the ops-bot will pause rollout if heartbeat misses 2 intervals.

tom: mock config snippet for the rollout policy: 

```
{"variant":"awq-int8-probe","env_split":{"hosted":0.8,"dedicated":0.15,"private":0.05},"traffic_probe":0.005,"stages":[{"pct":0.5,"hold":"6h"},{"pct":2,"hold":"12h"},{"pct":10,"hold":"24h"}],"rollback_on":["quality_regression","latency_spike","oom"]}
```

sasha: that looks good. Add a pinned eval set called probe_goldset with 2k examples: 50% QA, 30% conv/safety, 20% long-context summarization. we should run automatic evals every 30m during hold windows and publish diffs. :thumbsup: 

maya: ops-bot please schedule the dry-run and tag the owners for private envs.

ops-bot: scheduled dry-run for 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Notifying private env owners: @frank.

deploy-bot: dry-run job queued — job id dq-1799991111-01. will stream logs to /runs/dq-1799991111-01.

eli: quick question — do we plan to run the same quant binaries across all environments? i.e., same AWQ build for hosted and private?

maya: yes ideally identical artifact. but private may need different tuning flags for memory layout; we'll verify per-env perf profile and store per-env quant profile metadata.

frank: I'll add an ops checklist: env tuning flags, KMS access check, disk swap limits, and emergency rollback playbook.

sasha: one more item — add a small homogenous stress test that hits kv-cache heavy prefix reuse paths to catch subtle correctness regressions.

maya: agreed. let's reconvene after the dry-run logs. posting probe_goldset link in 15m. :eyes:
